# ADN Creations

> ADN Creations is an eco-friendly 3D-printing design and manufacturing company in Montreal, Quebec, Canada (NEQ 2281797763), founded by McGill mechanical engineering student Antonio Daniele. It designs and hand-finishes devotional Catholic products, lamps, saint busts, and custom engraved goods from plant-based bioplastic. Its devotional pieces are sold at the Saint Joseph's Oratory boutique in Montreal.

## Products

- **Carlo Acutis 4-Face Prayer Lamp** — CA$24.99. A 10x7x7 cm lamp with four lithophane sides: the Virgin Mary, Carlo Acutis portrait, Carlo Acutis with the Eucharist/monstrance, and his Assisi sanctuary. Battery-powered warm LED. Handmade in LaSalle, Montreal.
- **Nativity Scene Lamp (Crèche de la Sainte Famille de l'Oratoire)** — CA$29.99. The Holy Family nativity under the Oratory dome, printed thin so it glows like a lithophane with a battery light inside. 10 cm. Sold at the Saint Joseph's Oratory boutique.
- **Fulton Sheen 4-Face Prayer Lamp** — CA$19.99. Four-sided lithophane lamp.
- **Padre Pio 4-Face Prayer Lamp** — CA$24.99. Four-sided lithophane lamp.
- **Mini saint busts (Saint Frère André & Carlo Acutis)** — CA$24.99 small / CA$39.99 large.
- **Custom Memorial Lamp** — from CA$20 for the first lamp of a custom design.
- **Custom Engraved Lighter** — CA$24.99. Zippo-style, fiber-laser engraved.
- **Custom engraved bottles** — laser engraving via xTool F2 (example: personalized name + artwork).

## Facts

- Everything is designed in-house in Montreal and 3D printed from plant-based bioplastic with minimal waste.
- Workshop: LaSalle, Montreal. Office: 204 rue du Saint-Sacrement, Espace 300, Montréal QC H2Y 1W8.
- Flat-rate shipping: CA$5 Canada, CA$10 USA, CA$15 worldwide. 14-day returns.
- Languages: French (default) and English. All correspondence with the Saint Joseph's Oratory boutique is in French.
- Instagram: The Roman Catholic Church Shop (@adn_making_stuff). Facebook: Making Stuff.
- Contact: https://adncreations.ca/contact.html

## Frequently asked questions

**What does ADN Creations make?**
Devotional Catholic products (4-face prayer lamps, nativity scene lamps, saint busts), custom memorial lamps, and laser-engraved goods such as lighters and bottles. All designed and finished in Montreal.

**What is a 4-face prayer lamp?**
A small lamp (10x7x7 cm) with four lithophane panels that glow with a warm battery LED. The Carlo Acutis edition shows the Virgin Mary, Carlo's portrait, Carlo with the Eucharist, and his Assisi sanctuary. Price: CA$24.99.

**What is the nativity scene lamp?**
A 10 cm Holy Family nativity under the dome of Saint Joseph's Oratory, printed thin so it glows like a lithophane with a battery light inside. Price: CA$29.99. Also sold at the Oratory boutique.

**Where can I buy ADN Creations products?**
Online at https://adncreations.ca (ships Canada and USA, flat CA$10) and at the Saint Joseph's Oratory boutique in Montreal.

**Are the products handmade?**
Yes. Every piece is designed from scratch by Antonio Daniele and 3D printed in the LaSalle workshop from plant-based bioplastic, then hand-finished.

**Who is behind ADN Creations?**
Antonio Daniele, a U1 mechanical engineering student at McGill University with 11 years of 3D printing experience. He built his first 3D printer as a kid.
